findings.evidence: Both proofs are the identical `induction u with | tmul z T => induction v with | tmul w v => simp | add ... | add u w hu hw => simp only [map_add, add_apply, hu, hw]`. The bundle statement only mentions `V x`, `V y`, `L x`, `L y` and `U`, `S`, never the bundle structure.
findings.fix: Derive it from `homComplexificationLinearEquiv_naturality` with `U.symm`/`S` and `v := U.baseChangeComplex v'`, or drop it. The intrinsic lemma already applies to the fibres `V x`, `L x` and accepts continuous linear maps, not only equivalences.
findings.issue: `bundleHomComplexificationEquiv_naturality` repeats the induction proof of the general `homComplexificationLinearEquiv_naturality` (Topology/Algebra/Module/Complexification.lean). The bundle version is a special case: equivalences of two fibres of one bundle. It also needlessly requires `FiberBundle`/`VectorBundle` structure and the models `F`, `G`.

findings.evidence: The definition sets `toLinearEquiv := homComplexificationLinearEquiv`. The wrappers are proved by `exact homComplexificationLinearEquiv_tmul_apply_tmul`, `exact homComplexificationLinearEquiv_apply u`, `exact homComplexificationLinearEquiv_symm_apply A` and `exact homComplexificationLinearEquiv_conj u v`.
findings.fix: Add a single `@[simp]` lemma such as `bundleHomComplexificationEquiv_toLinearEquiv : (bundleHomComplexificationEquiv x).toLinearEquiv = homComplexificationLinearEquiv` (or a coercion lemma). Use it to reach the intrinsic API and delete the restated wrappers.
findings.issue: `bundleHomComplexificationEquiv_tmul_apply_tmul`, `_apply`, `_symm_apply` and `_conj` each restate an intrinsic `homComplexificationLinearEquiv_*` lemma with an `exact`. They carry unused bundle hypotheses and implicit model parameters `F`, `G`, which is why every caller needs `(F := F) (G := G) (V := V) (L := L)`.

summary: The prior blocker is fixed: the comparison now covers arbitrary real source and target models. Two generality problems remain: the bundle naturality lemma repeats the intrinsic naturality proof, and the intrinsic fibre formulas are restated under bundle hypotheses they do not use.
